newsitem.title: USA: United Tech's Sikorsky signs $113 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: United Tech's Sikorsky signs $113 mln deal.

text.p: United Technologies Corp's Sikorsky Aircraft Corp said Friday it signed a $113 million contract with the Government of Turkey for four S-70B Seahawk helicopters.
The contract was signed on Thursday, Sikorsky said in a statement.
The naval helicopters will be delivered in 1999.
Sikorsky said the contract was for a direct commercial sale, and that it included spares, ground support equipment and training.
The S-70 is the international derivative of the Hawk helicopter line, whose original Black Hawk was designed for the U.S. Army in 1978.
Turkey already operates a fleet of more than 50 Black Hawks, the company said.
Sikorsky is the world's biggest designer and manufacturer of helicopters.
